args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The function was using ROUND_HALF_UP while tests and FIN-212 require
ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Also aligns the implementation with its docstring.

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` implements `round_money` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in `round_money`. This also brings the implementation in line with its existing docstring, which already said "banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212".

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py` (`2.665` → `2.66` half-even behavior).
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding

I did not merge the PR, since merging into main requires code-owner approval — that's now in alex's hands.
